name: dsh-peak-hours
description: DSH plugin bundle: model-aware peak-pricing hours for DeepSeek and GLM routes — a header indicator, a composer defer button, an automatic session pause that resumes at the window end, a working 'allow peak hours' override with a daily budget, a settings page for the schedules, and a peak_hours_status tool for the model.

scripts.test: node tests/schedule.test.mjs && node tests/state.test.mjs && node --test tests/pause.test.mjs && node --test tests/defer.test.mjs && node tests/client.test.mjs && node activation.test.mjs
